advice.kickoff: Program funded, Systems Integrator (SI) selected, date set. Start with Project Role Readiness at kickoff, inside a phased OCM Leadership engagement: Prepare first.
advice.delivery: You’re in delivery. OCM Leadership runs the Act phase, with contract associates for production work and a Readiness Assessment coming at 90 days or less.
advice.assess: 90 days or less before go-live: a 3–4 week Readiness Assessment. Know, with evidence, whether people can perform. It leads into gap-closure work.
advice.after: Go-live plus 90 days: the Sustain check-in. A read on adoption, and planning for the next initiative.
